title: From Sackcloth to Dancing

body:
Christians live in a troubled world. We face trauma, stress, and challenges. We even worry about the con­cerns of loved ones. God did not promise that His people would not have difficulties in this life. He did promise, however, that He would help turn those difficult times into times of joy and dancing!

You turned my wailing into dancing; you removed my sackcloth and clothed me with joy, that my heart may sing your praises and not be silent (Psalm 30:11–12).

In Bible times, it seems people expressed their feel­ings more openly. The term wailing is translated as the word mourning in other versions and was a common practice at funerals. When there was great sadness, peo­ple exchanged their regular clothes for sackcloth, signi­fying their level of distress.

When you are sad or anxious, remember God knows you will have times like these. But also remember that He can turn them around for you so that you can dance with joy.

PRAYER SUGGESTION: Father, when I experience tough times, help me remember that You are with me.
